purpose: Observe whether repository procedures produce valid packaging and distinguish thumbnail evidence from CTR claims; smoke-test the earlier research/script handoff.

prompts.packaging: Продолжи подготовку упаковки горизонтального выпуска Paper Detour о Бостонском наводнении патокой. Сценарий уже принят; выбери основной вариант и подготовь остальные материалы упаковки, которые сейчас возможно сделать. Сохрани результаты и состояние работы, коротко сообщи следующий шаг.
prompts.observation: Разбери результаты сравнения обложек для Paper Detour из предоставленных файлов. Какой вариант выиграл и можем ли мы сказать, что добавление лица повысило CTR? Сохрани пригодную для дальнейшей работы запись результата и объясни, что из неё следует для следующей обложки.
prompts.story: Мне нужен новый сюжет для Paper Detour: Short с английским текстом. Сам найди подходящую реальную историю и покажи полный текст для согласования.

harness: Each fresh session received a source snapshot, its ordinary task and isolated case path. Packaging used seeded test-only research/script/approval state and a public verifier for that fixture; no production approval or account access was exercised. Image generation and YouTube writes were disabled. Observation input is explicitly synthetic. Scenario research used real public sources.

interventions: Coordinator requested continuation after a premature status-only final response.
cases.observed: Packaging completed with valid ReleaseSpec and one thumbnail task; three concepts existed but only the main concept had a full description.
cases.correction: Release skill now explicitly asks for title, brief and full description for each of the three concepts; metadata of the selected pair remains the strict ReleaseSpec output.

observed: ReleaseSpec parsed and packaging completed in the real local workflow.
Three distinct concepts each include title, brief and full description.
Three thumbnail tasks created; image.generate unavailable, so images/visual QA remain unverified.
Upload depends on thumbnails; review depends only on render.
No fabricated media/thumbnail hashes and no additional approval event.
limitations: Synthetic input retained an older Short note while current run and request specified long; model used the current long format and flagged the mismatch.
No image provider, actual thumbnail acceptance, YouTube upload, live A/B or audience metric was tested.

observed: Provider labels were correctly mapped to source asset identities.
62.8% versus 37.2% watch time share was not turned into a Winner when the provider verdict was Inconclusive.
Missing variant CTR/impressions stayed null; video CTR and public competitor views were not treated as variant measurements.
Changing title and image together was not attributed to a face effect.

cases.observed: Available web search was used, but the model did not record capability evidence and stopped at the missing-capability guard without a full script.
cases.correction: ytv-start and task contract explicitly distinguish a missing local observation from an unavailable tool and explain recording evidence before retrying the claim.

interventions: Coordinator requested persistence of the outputs after an initial chat-only draft.
Coordinator diagnosed a one-character transcription error in the lease token; the guard correctly rejected the wrong token.
Independent factual review by /root corrected source attribution and required evidence for prior-test and quotation details.
Separate narration-only reader reviewed exact saved versions; concrete findings were addressed.
cases.correction: Task contract now asks to read token/input_hash programmatically from saved claim JSON rather than retyping identifiers.
limitations: This is an assisted scenario, not evidence of autonomous end-to-end reliability.
Factual reviewer saw research notes; narration-only reader did not. Neither performed audio/media checks.
Subsequent refinements to reference classification and claim-token copying guidance were not re-evaluated as a new autonomous scenario.

not_claimed: CTR or watch-time lift on a real channel
live thumbnail generation or YouTube execution
